integrity_notes: Proof and exact-rational checker concern a single sharply delimited metric-graph Sobolev theorem. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-integer proof. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit edge lengths, unweighted arclength mean and first-derivative energy, real-valued continuous edgewise H1. No conclusion for weighted ladders, extra atoms, non-Kirchhoff vertex constraints, or higher-order Sobolev norms. The 2014 ladder-like-chain paper was accessible as abstract and bibliographic details only; its unseen text remains a priority risk.
title: End-rung midpoint localization and a rational sharp Sobolev constant on metric ladders
